claim: AIHW Hospitals at a glance Table 2 reports 9,094,312 emergency department presentations (total row, 2024–25). This is a count of presentation events at Australian public-hospital emergency departments, not a count of unique people and not an arrival rate or temporal process. Table 2 labels its accompanying denominator as all presentations. The five triage-category counts sum to 9,091,132, which is 3,180 below the displayed total; this discrepancy is preserved for independent review and no replacement total or reconciliation is inferred.
